description: Cancel an open CEX order by order id. Needs trade:execute. CANCELS ARE NEVER BLOCKED BY THE KILL SWITCH (D4): a cancel always passes, even with the switch on or autonomy=propose_only — the switch stops NEW positions only.

market.description: Optional market scope. Omit to search both.
